_comment: Reviewed voice edits from the LiveWell voice audit. Each edit is an EXACT find->replace within one essay (matched by slug), never a global swap. severity 'forbidden' = a banned word is actually present; these default to apply. 'review' items are intentionally NOT listed here (e.g. Beatitudes 'Blessed', literal 'foster care') because they should stay. The applier refuses any edit whose 'find' does not occur exactly once, so a stale slug or reworded sentence is skipped, never guessed.
